invariants: ListBinding.inc stores application rows and complete native state/selection/pixels and owns host-epoch cache lifetime. Lists.inc and Inputs.inc remain the existing shared transport. No list/control, selection, navigation, drawing, layout or tracking algorithm is copied.

Gecko reuses the retained popup model for exact option/group identities, original DOM traversal, label/visibility and disabled access. Per-option ElementState CHECKED and original multiple attribute supply the list-specific application data. Retained model nodes keep IDs alive during native tracking.

One shared guarded ScrollContainerFrame display entry serves existing text and new list callers; list code never overwrites the text detour. The entry calls the existing border/background/outline builder for owned native lists; the existing themed display-item fallback carries complete native pixels. Actual browser UI process role, frame vtable, primary frame, native appearance and scale eligibility apply.

Native key/pointer results become original SetOptionsSelectedByIndex calls using Notify/NoReselect, followed by original UserFinishedInteracting for changed selectedness. The adapter revalidates the original model, forwards trusted uncancelled input, retains the semantic node across completion callbacks and reacquires its live binding afterward.

Original select model observers request ordinary engine repaint after label/text changes. The existing EventStateManager post boundary forwards outside move/release once. Appearance loss, frame retirement, page freezing and inactive shell release the native binding through existing owner/lifetime paths.

Ordinary native responder calls supply key selection/focus expectations. A separate actual native NSBrowser window receives the same outside gesture and yields exact whole pixels and per-cell state, avoiding a reconstructed oracle that omits native visual state.

Only the small optional adapter and native test probe are built. Original browsers, AppKit/backend, shared provider/loader/shim and their ABI 1/568 remain unchanged. Browser toolbar/address bar/tabs remain original.
